reviews.comment: Good fan, worked properly. Quiet and super easy to install. Looks great and it matched my son's pc fans.

reviews.title: Bought it with NZXT H6 Flow
reviews.author: Everett Dodd

reviews.title: Good quality PWM fans
reviews.comment: Performance is good, noise level is okay. It was easy to install and can be daisy chained with the cables provided. I bought 3 of them and one did not have any screws for installation. 4 star because of that. Maintains airflow as expected. Overall good value for money.
reviews.author: Dbhowmik
